Ferramenta: image_gen integrada. Atlas RGBA originais; importação recorta e acrescenta margens transparentes sem redesenhar a arte.

AuraBody
Use case: stylized-concept / production game visual effects texture. Create an ACTUAL TRANSPARENT RGBA animated sprite atlas: exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, SIXTEEN equal square cells, chronological order left to right, top to bottom. No grid lines, no labels, no characters or environment, no background or cast shadow. Each cell contains one complete isolated effect with at least 12% fully transparent padding on every edge so the frames never overlap or touch. Cinematic physically rich semi-realistic luminous energy: complex turbulent flowing plasma, feathery vapor, fine luminous filaments and varied transparency, gold/amber with soft ivory-hot highlights, subtle volumetric light scattering. Organic fluid shapes only, NO circles, rings, spherical outlines, hexagons, triangles, polygons, rigid beams, hard silhouettes, solid white blobs, ground discs, or graphic symbols. Preserve genuine alpha, including the translucent feathered edges; the game will add the bloom. Keep overall location and scale registered between cells for smooth animation. A LOOPING 16-frame tall upright power AURA enclosing the space of a standing human body. A broad layered flame/plasma sheath rises from a low shared root, curls up both sides and joins loose wisps above the head. Rich detail through the whole volume, not just an outline. Outer vapor, intermediate amber tendrils and fine ivory filaments. Thin translucent interior so a character drawn over it stays readable. No human visible. Effect occupies central 70% cell width and 78% height. Smooth turbulent cycle with coherent evolving eddies and no dramatic changes in size; final frame joins first.

A LOOPING 16-frame FRONT LAYER for a character-enveloping energy aura. Very airy translucent gold plasma ribbons and curled wisps rise and weave gently across the lower and middle portions of an imaginary standing body, while the upper center where a face would be stays mostly empty. Uneven thin filaments also lick up left and right sides. No border outline. This is a sparse front veil, much lighter and more transparent than a full flame, with visible space between flowing strands. Effect occupies central 70% width and 78% height. No body or figure. Cycle smoothly.

A ONE-SHOT 16-frame organic POWER ERUPTION animation. Starts as a small knot of swirling plasma, rapidly blooms into a broad asymmetric explosion of feathery outward-curling energy tongues and tangled filaments, then thins into drifting shreds and dissipates to almost transparent in the last frame. No ring shape or shockwave circle, no solid central ball. Complex 3D-looking depth with curved ribbons passing in front and behind, bright core only for the early peak frames, center opens quickly to reveal a character underneath. A LOOPING 16-frame organic electrical PLASMA FILAMENT CLUSTER. Several very thin uneven branching ivory-gold filaments flicker and crawl loosely upward with soft luminous vapor clinging around them. Long meandering natural turbulent curves with occasional sharp tiny branches, not regular zigzags or line art. Mostly transparent space. Roughly vertical effect, not a ring or ball; no endpoints at canvas edges. These are rare electrical discharges layered over an aura, not a solid flame. Keep delicate and restrained, no starlike symbols.
